mapper.select: SELECT pad.report_no, pad.document_id, pad.investigation_id, ROUND((pad.damage_amount * pad.fault_ratio::numeric / 100), 2) AS paid_amount, pad.submission_status, ar.accident_status FROM payment_approval_document pad JOIN accident_report ar ON ar.report_no = pad.report_no WHERE pad.report_no = #{accidentNumber} ORDER BY pad.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.subrogation_id, s.report_no, s.document_id, s.investigation_id, s.offender_name, s.subrogation_reason, s.subrogation_amount, s.employee_no, s.subrogation_status, ROUND((pad.damage_amount * pad.fault_ratio::numeric / 100), 2) AS paid_amount, pad.submission_status, ar.accident_status, s.recovered_amount, s.recovered_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM subrogation s JOIN payment_approval_document pad ON pad.document_id = s.document_id JOIN accident_report ar ON ar.report_no = s.report_no WHERE s.report_no = #{accidentNumber} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subrogation ( subrogation_id, report_no, document_id, investigation_id, offender_name, subrogation_reason, subrogation_amount, employee_no, subrogation_status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{subrogationId}, #{accidentNumber}, #{documentId}, #{investigationId}, #{targetName}, #{subrogationReason}, #{subrogationAmount}, #{employeeNo}, #{subrogationStatus}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt} )
